translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: 2 Timotius
book.title: Surat Ni Paulus Men Kopinduan Boni TIMOTIUS

content: Tabea'
Yaku' i Paulus, poposuu' ni Kristus Yesus' gause pingkira'na Alaata'ala. Yaku' niposuu' kada' mengelelekon toonna tutuo' men pore men mimpu'u ni Kristus Yesus.
Bona i Timotius, men yaku' popo'anakmo ka' men kolingu'ku! Sulano kaporean, lino-linoan, ka' koratongan men ringkat na Alaata'ala Tama na surugaa ka' i Kristus Yesus, Tumpunta, surioon na tutuo'om.
Puntunde' ni Paulus Tumpu tia bantilina boni Timotius
Yaku' basukuur na Alaata'ala men soosa'onku tia noa men molinas koi men ia limangmo pulingku tempo mbaripian. Ka' ilio malom, na sambayangku, yaku' sinampang minginau' i koo.
Kalu yaku' tonginau' lolu'um, yaku' mingkira' mae' mengelego'i koo soosoodo kada' i yaku' tuutuu' munsuri beles.
Gause yaku' tonginau' na imaawan men tuutuu' malolo', men koimo imaanna ina'am men i Lois ka' uga' koi imaanna sinaam men i Eunike. Surionku imaawan uga' koiya'a.
Mbali' rorongikononku na ko'oom kada' i koo tio mangkakatkon mingilimang limaang tia barakaat men ia rookon Alaata'ala, tempo i yaku' nengepetkon lima na ko'oom.
Gause Alus men rookononna Alaata'ala na ko'onta' taasi'po Alus men minsidakon i kita layaon, kasee Alus men mompopomoonggor i kita ka' minsidakon i kita molingu' ka' mambarios wakanta.

Mbaka' alia makamaa' mompotuutuu' Tumpunta, ka' uga' alia mangkakamaa'kon montookon i yaku' nitarungku gause mengelelekon Lele Pore. Kasee sulano Alaata'ala mompopomoonggor i koo kada' momoko mongololo' i yaku' mongololongi repaan gause i koo mongololo' Lele Pore iya'a.

Alaata'ala a men nansalamatkon i kita ka' nengeleelo' i kita kada' sida mian-Na. Ia nangawawau men koiya'a taasi' montookon limangta, kasee men koiya'a nosida koi pingkira'-Na. Kristus Yesus a kaporean-Na men Ia rookon bo ko'onta' koo'po tia isian tano' balaki' kani'i.

Ka' Alaata'ala nimpipiile'konmo na ko'onta' polingu'-Na iya'a. Ia nantakakon i Yesus Kristus men Pansalamatkon i kita. Yesus a men nungurungku'imo kolapusan ka' nantakakon tutuo' men sidutu koi men na Lele Pore.
Yaku' ia nakatmo Alaata'ala sida poposuu' ka' sida guru kada' bo pengelelekon Lele Pore iya'a.

Mbali' yaku' muntuungi giigii' repaan kani'i. Kasee i yaku' sian mangkakamaa'kon, gause yaku' inti-inti'i men parasayaonku. Yaku' mingintii se' i Ia kuasaan mandagai upa men Ia pokaumo na ingku' pataka na ilio kotakaanna Tumpu.
Tontoni a pisiso' men kana' men koo rongor na ingku', ka' koo piile' tontonionku. Limang a men koiya'a tia kaparasaya'aan ka' polingu'um men ringkat ni Kristus Yesus.
Dagai a upa men umangga', men Ia pokaumo na ko'oom. Alus Molinas men dumodongo na wakanta a bo Pangalawei i koo.
Koo inti-inti'i se' giigii' mian men isian na Poropinsi Asia namarereimo i yaku' tonsoop i Figelus tii Hermogenes.
Kasee ari Onesiforus sangkau laigan piripiimo nompopobeles noangku. Sulano Tumpu mimpipiile'kon polingu'-Na na ko'ona i raaya'a. Onesiforus sian nangkakamaa'kon kokootku na tarungkuan.
Tempo i yaku' notaka na Roma ia nampari-pari nansarak i yaku' pataka ia sida nopootuung tii yaku'.
Sulano Tumpu mimpipiile'kon polingu'-Na ni Onesiforus na ilio kotakaanna Tumpu. Koo uga' minginti'i se' biai' tuu' a upa men ia limang na Efesus.
